title: Building and shipping Mac and iOS apps without opening Xcode #Shorts
description:
Turns out you don't need Xcode open to build and ship apps for Apple platforms. Swift Package Manager, fastlane, and a good text editor cover the full pipeline — builds, signing, and App Store uploads included. If Xcode's sluggishness has been slowing you down, this workflow is worth trying today.

#iosdev #macdev #swiftlang #xcode #fastlane #devtools #appdevelopment #developerlife #Shorts
